Fresenius Medical Care to Exit Some China Operations in Portfolio Reshuffle
By Adria Calatayud
Fresenius Medical Care said it would stop production and sales of a dialysis machine in China and exit a business there, as it moves to refine its portfolio in the country.

The German dialysis specialist said it expects to book one-time costs of about 110 million euros ($125.2 million) in its third-quarter earnings as a result of the portfolio changes. The adjustment isn't expected to affect the revenue outlook for the group's dialysis-equipment business in China, it added.

The company said it would seek to focus on innovative technologies for in-center dialysis and critical care, and that it would discontinue production and sales of its 4008A hemodialysis system locally and exit its China peritoneal dialysis business. It plans to maintain existing obligations in the market, it said.
Fresenius Medical Care also said it named Rex Liu as general manager in China.
China represents between 6% and 7% in Fresenius Medical Care's dialysis-equipment segment, and the group said it sees long-term growth opportunities there.
